paragraphs.zh:
发明名称
三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺
paragraphs.en: Title of invention: Synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione (环磺草酮)
paragraphs.notes: See the naming note on the (57) abstract regarding the identification of 环磺草酮.

paragraphs.zh:
摘要
本发明涉及一种三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺,包括有以下步骤:1)2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成;2)2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成;3)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成;4)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成;5)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成;6)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成;7)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯的合成;8)环磺草酮的合成。本发明的有益效果在于:缩短了反应步骤和时间,提高了中间体的收率;反应条件更温和,更安全;成本降低。
paragraphs.en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione (环磺草酮), comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that: the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediates is raised; the reaction conditions are milder and safer; the cost is lowered.
paragraphs.notes: VERBATIM CAVEAT: the printed abstract inserts justification gaps at every CJK/Latin boundary (printed as e.g. '步骤 :1)2- 氯 -6- 甲磺酰'). Those gaps are typesetting artifacts of the CNIPA abstract renderer, not space characters in the source, so they are NOT reproduced in the zh field. All punctuation IS reproduced exactly as printed: verified at 3x zoom, the abstract uses HALF-WIDTH ',' ';' ':' '(' ')' and half-width hyphen-minus '-', with only the sentence-final stop full-width '。'. No full-width '，' '；' '：' appears anywhere in this abstract. CHEMISTRY NOTE 1 (not an error): the ring numbering changes between step 2 and step 3 because the parent changes from toluene to benzoic acid. In step 2 (toluene parent) C1=CH3, C2=Cl, C3=acetyl, C6=SO2CH3; after the acetyl carbon becomes COOH it takes locant C1, giving step 3's C1=COOH, C2=Cl, C3=CH3, C4=SO2CH3. The two names describe the same substitution pattern. CHEMISTRY NOTE 2 (possible internal inconsistency, flagged not resolved): step 5 ends at the methyl ester (苯甲酸甲酯) but step 6 names a free acid (苯甲酸), with no hydrolysis step named in between. Either step 6 silently combines etherification with ester hydrolysis, or '甲酯' is omitted from the step 6 name. Translated literally as printed; must be checked against the description pages. NAME NOTE: 环磺草酮 is translated as tembotrione. That identification is not taken from the Chinese name alone; it follows from the route in the abstract (2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid coupled to a cyclohexane-1,3-dione via the 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl ester), which is the tembotrione skeleton. No structure is drawn on this page to confirm it.
